files.title: File:Ludwig Larsen apartments, part of Erickson-Larsen Ensemble (Astoria, Ore), 2012.jpg
files.author: Steve Morgan
files.caption: The Ludwig Larsen apartments (built ca. 1885) are part of the Erickson-Larsen Ensemble (built 1877–ca. 1885), in Astoria, Oregon, which is listed on the U.S. National Register of Historic Places. In this 2012 photo, the building is boarded-up and out of use.
